description: Read your own Direct account ledger: the signed-in account’s UTC free-send allowance, prepaid balance in cents, reserved cents and last 20 charges. It never buys credit and does not list costs (see get_m2m_network). Use it before sending tasks that may cost credit; a payment_required reply from send_to_business carries the top-up link. Uses the same ledger as REST and your developer page. Requires direct:tasks and sign-in. Changes nothing; phone minutes and legacy credits are tracked separately. Example: call it with no arguments before a booking to confirm the allowance or balance covers it.
name: get_direct_usage
title: Your Direct allowance and credits
